title: Gumroad website and brand, 2021
lede: The creator-commerce platform’s tenth-anniversary redesign, the example most often cited for the style.
summary: Gumroad’s November 2021 brand and website, cited by Malewicz and NN/g as neo-brutalist.

evidence.note: Wayback Machine capture of gumroad.com from 15 January 2022, captured with `tools/capture.mjs` (headless Chrome, 1440 × 900) and inspected on 25 September 2026, plus the founder’s announcement graphic. The live site was also inspected on that date and no longer shows the style.

styles.note: Malewicz (2022) calls Gumroad one of the “two main innovators” of neubrutalism, and NN/g (2025) uses it as an example.

context: On 26 November 2021 Sahil Lavingia wrote: “Gumroad is ten years old, and we're beginning the next 10 years worth of bets with a new brand (and website, fonts, colors, and more!)” ([announcement](https://sahil.gumroad.com/p/introducing-the-new-gumroad)). The linked essay “Betting on the new Gumroad” is archived from the same day.

[Michał Malewicz, “Neubrutalism is taking over the web” (Hype4 Academy, first published 28 March 2022)](https://hype4.academy/articles/design/neubrutalism-is-taking-over-web) names Figma and Gumroad as the style’s “two main innovators” and describes Gumroad’s mix of illustration, photography, fake 3D, and parallax.
[NN/g, “Neobrutalism: Definition and Best Practices” (Hayat Sheikh, 11 April 2025)](https://www.nngroup.com/articles/neobrutalism/) cites Gumroad as an example of neobrutalism in practice.
Gumroad’s code was released on GitHub under the MIT License in 2025 ([antiwork/gumroad](https://github.com/antiwork/gumroad)). That licence does not clearly cover the brand artwork.
observed: Archived home page (January 2022): the gumroad wordmark runs across the full width in huge black letters.
Navigation links sit in a row divided by thin black rules. Start Selling is a black block.
The hero splits into a flat pink panel and a flat yellow panel. The yellow panel holds a photo of a woman cut out with a thick black outline, plus outlined sticker illustrations.
Type is a single grotesque family (Mabry Pro), black on white or on color. The Start Selling button is a square black rectangle.
No component showed a shadow at rest in the measurement.
In the announcement graphic: pink “G” discs with black outlines and solid black extrusions on a flat yellow blob.
interpretation: The archived home page shows the flat-bright, black-outline, square-corner side of the style but not hard offset shadows at rest. Either the shadows appear only in hover states and deeper pages, or hard shadows are less central to the style than the fingerprint assumes. This record is calibration evidence for the fingerprint.
borrow: Let the brand illustration use the same outline weight and hard depth as the interface components.
next: Check hover states and product pages in the same capture for hard offset shadows.
Capture a December 2021 copy for comparison with the January 2022 one.

rights.statement: Gumroad’s design and content belong to Gumroad. Captured from the Internet Archive for commentary.

notice: The live gumroad.com no longer uses this design. On 25 September 2026 it had a black background, rounded cards (median radius 25 px), 1 px borders, and no shadows. This record describes the 2021–2022 design through an archived copy.
